answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. A comet of per-task receipts records who did what, and the crystal of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on time-locked work history, published publicly on failure, idle agents bleed standing. By the nectar of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
